data.name: Balram
data.gender_notes: Balram is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Strong as a bull; Rama's brother
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit bala, 'strength', + Rāma — 'strong Rama'. Its root is Sanskrit bala + rāma. Balarama, brother of Krishna. Balram is a Sanskrit name meaning “Strong as a bull; Rama's brother”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Balram expresses “Strong as a bull; Rama's brother”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit bala, 'strength', + Rāma — 'strong Rama'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balram total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Balram is a name of Lord Krishna, who was born as the eighth son of King Ajamila and Queen Devaki. He is also known as Baladeva and Balabhadra.
